name: Satan And A Third Of Angels Caste Out Of Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that Satan, once a glorious being called Lucifer, was cast out of heaven due to his rebellion, as described in Isaiah 14:12 and Luke 10:18. This fall involved a significant portion of the heavenly host, with Revelation 12:4 depicting a third of the angels being cast down alongside the dragon, symbolizing Satan. The cosmic conflict continues with Michael and his angels warring against the dragon and his angels, emphasizing the spiritual battle that originated from Satan's pride and subsequent expulsion. Job 1:7 also highlights Satan's ongoing activity on earth after his expulsion from heaven.
